children: GMX will disable its v2.2b contracts on September 14th. Direct integrators should migrate to v2.2c; trading through the GMX application will not be affected.
If you are calling the GMX contracts directly, follow the Tech Announcements channel on Telegram for relevant updates:
For questions or migration support, please contact a GMX contributor in Telegram.
GMX is a decentralized spot and perpetual exchange that supports low swap fees and zero price impact trades.
Trading is supported by a unique multi-asset pool that earns liquidity providers fees from market making, swap fees, leverage trading (spreads, funding fees & liquidations) and asset rebalancing.
Dynamic pricing is supported by Chainlink Oracles along with TWAP pricing from leading volume DEXs.

title: GMX to Conduct Scheduled Maintenance on September 14th
